messages.subject: [Service Interruption] 8/2/2017 (Resolved)
parts:
All,

We are currently experiencing a service disruption on shinyapps.io. This is impacting both deploying and launching applications on shinyapps.io.

We apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience.  

-The shinyapps.io Team
